entries.title: Clarify quote totals
entries.description: Quote documents now show work-item amounts without duplicating Labour and Parts costs, while preserving any remaining charge.

entries.title: Run stocktakes
entries.description: Open and manage stocktake sessions, review count variances, and follow count records from stock movement history.

entries.title: Cross-check supplier invoices
entries.description: Upload supplier invoices to purchase orders and review extracted details against the order, including any differences that need attention.

entries.title: Review job material variance
entries.description: See the material quantities and costs used against each job, with more accurate pricing when material is returned.

entries.title: Identify bay operators
entries.description: Planner bay rows now show each operator’s first name.

entries.title: Load more jobs when issuing stock
entries.description: The Checkout and Return to Store job picker can now load eligible jobs beyond its initial list.

entries.title: Close fully returned orders
entries.description: Purchase orders whose received goods were all returned can now be closed short when a replacement will not arrive.

entries.title: Use the correct drawing dimensions
entries.description: Product image guidance now recommends the correct wide technical-drawing dimensions.

entries.title: Manage quotes by invoice number
entries.description: Quote lists now display invoice numbers and let you search, sort, and filter by whether a quote has been invoiced.

entries.title: Find slurry tank products
entries.description: Visits to the legacy slurry tank flyer now take you to the products page.

entries.title: Count stock on the shop floor
entries.description: Use guided stocktake sessions to count parts, review corrections, recount items, and close a completed walk.

entries.title: Find Stores at the end of navigation
entries.description: The Stores tab now appears at the end of the toolbar.
